---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast), by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    Player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    active_steroid_era = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(Player, career_home_runs),
    fill = active_steroid_era
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Active during steroid era",
    values = c("No" = "gray60", "Yes" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database. Active means a career overlapped 1994-2009."
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
